title: ADGRE5-centered Tsurv model in T cells recognizes responders to neoadjuvant cancer immunotherapy.
authors: Li, Jian; Meng, Zhouwenli; Cao, Zhengqi; Lu, Wenqing; Yang, Yi; Li, Ziming; Lu, Shun
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦T细胞亚群与肿瘤免疫治疗响应预测，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy with anti-programmed death-1 (neo-antiPD1) has revolutionized perioperative methods for improvement of overall survival (OS), while approaches for major pathologic response patients' (MPR) recognition along with methods for overcoming non-MPR resistance are still in urgent need. METHODS: We utilized and integrated publicly-available immune checkpoint inhibitors regimens (ICIs) single-cell (sc) data as the discovery datasets, and innovatively developed a cell-communication analysis pipeline, along with a VIPER-based-SCENIC process, to thoroughly dissect MPR-responding subsets. Besides, we further employed our own non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ICIs cohort's sc data for validation in-silico. Afterward, we resorted to ICIs-resistant murine models developed by us with multimodal investigation, including bulk-RNA-sequencing, Chip-sequencing and high-dimensional cytometry by time of flight (CYTOF) to consolidate our findings in-vivo. To comprehensively explore mechanisms, we adopted 3D ex-vivo hydrogel models for analysis. Furthermore, we constructed an ADGRE5-centered Tsurv model from our discovery dataset by machine learning (ML) algorithms for a wide range of tumor types (NSCLC, melanoma, urothelial cancer, etc.) and verified it in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) sc datasets. RESULTS: Through a meta-analysis of multimodal sequential sc sequencing data from pre-ICIs and post-ICIs, we identified an MPR-expanding T cells meta-cluster (MPR-E) in the tumor microenvironment (TME), characterized by a stem-like CD8(+) T cluster (survT) with STAT5-ADGRE5 axis enhancement compared to non-MPR or pre-ICIs TME. Through multi-omics analysis of murine TME, we further confirmed the existence of survT with silenced function and immune checkpoints (ICs) in MPR-E. After verification of the STAT5-ADGRE5 axis of survT in independent ICIs cohorts, an ADGRE5-centered Tsurv model was then developed through ML for identification of MPR patients pre-ICIs and post-ICIs, both in TME and PBMCs, which was further verified in pan-cancer immunotherapy cohorts. Mechanistically, we unveiled ICIs stimulated ADGRE5 upregulation in a STAT5-IL32 dependent manner in a 3D ex-vivo system (3D-HYGTIC) developed by us previously, which marked Tsurv with better survival flexibility, enhanced stemness and potential cytotoxicity within TME. CONCLUSION: Our research provides insights into mechanisms underlying MPR in neo-antiPD1 and a well-performed model for the identification of non-MPR.
abstract_zh: 背景：新辅助抗程序性死亡-1免疫治疗（neo-antiPD1）已革新了改善总生存期（OS）的围手术期方法，而用于识别主要病理反应患者（MPR）的方法以及克服非MPR耐药性的策略仍亟需开发。方法：我们利用并整合了公开可用的免疫检查点抑制剂方案（ICIs）单细胞（sc）数据作为发现数据集，并创新性地开发了一种细胞通讯分析流程，以及基于VIPER的SCENIC过程，以深入解析MPR反应性亚群。此外，我们进一步采用自身非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）ICIs队列的单细胞数据进行计算机模拟验证。随后，我们借助自行开发的ICIs耐药小鼠模型，结合多模态研究，包括批量RNA测序、染色质免疫沉淀测序和高维飞行时间细胞计数（CYTOF），以在体内巩固我们的发现。为全面探索机制，我们采用3D离体水凝胶模型进行分析。此外，我们通过机器学习（ML）算法从发现数据集构建了一个以ADGRE5为中心的Tsurv模型，适用于多种肿瘤类型（NSCLC、黑色素瘤、尿路上皮癌等），并在外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）单细胞数据集中进行了验证。结果：通过对ICIs治疗前和治疗后多模态时序单细胞测序数据的荟萃分析，我们在肿瘤微环境（TME）中识别出一个MPR扩增性T细胞元簇（MPR-E），其特征为干细胞样CD8(+) T细胞簇（survT），与非MPR或ICIs治疗前TME相比，STAT5-ADGRE5轴增强。通过小鼠TME的多组学分析，我们进一步确认了MPR-E中survT的存在，其功能沉默且免疫检查点（ICs）表达受抑。在独立ICIs队列中验证survT的STAT5-ADGRE5轴后，我们通过ML开发了一个以ADGRE5为中心的Tsurv模型，用于在ICIs治疗前和治疗后识别MPR患者，涵盖TME和PBMCs，并在泛癌种免疫治疗队列中进一步验证。机制上，我们在先前开发的3D离体系统（3D-HYGTIC）中揭示了ICIs以STAT5-IL32依赖性方式刺激ADGRE5上调，这标志着survT在TME内具有更好的生存灵活性、增强的干性和潜在细胞毒性。结论：我们的研究为neo-antiPD1中MPR的潜在机制提供了见解，并提供了一个性能良好的模型用于识别非MPR。
